primaryUnit: one independently published complete audio recording, represented by its unverified automatic transcript
tokenizer: Unicode NFKC, curly apostrophe normalization, lowercase ASCII alphabetic words with optional internal apostrophe; lexical-rate denominator includes one-letter tokens; TF-IDF excludes one-letter tokens
receiptWordCounts: Preserved separately from common analysis-token counts; ASR receipt uses whitespace words, authored receipt uses its original extractor definition

tfidf.stopWords: sklearn English stoplist excluding no/not/nor/never, plus predeclared spoken filler list in build.py
tfidf.fits: 20 ASR documents and 16 publisher texts fitted separately
tfidf.crossModality: Publisher texts transformed in the ASR-fitted vocabulary/IDF only for labeled lexical projection; no pooled topic or cluster fit

topics.selection: Predeclared interpretability display choice, not an estimated true number of topics
topics.rowNormalization: Nonnegative document-topic weights normalized to sum1
topics.stability: Hungarian matched mean cosine of L2-normalized topic-term rows relative to seed11 at each K; diagnostic, not validity
topics.fits: Separate20audio and16publisher-text fits; topic IDs and weights are never pooled

clusters.displaySelection: Highest cosine silhouette among seed11 candidate fits; all candidates retained
clusters.stability: Adjusted Rand index against seed11 labels across seeds
clusters.projection: Two-component TruncatedSVD fitted only to ASR TF-IDF; publisher comparison points are projections through the same fitted vocabulary and SVD
clusters.fits: Separate20audio and16publisher-text fits; source/genre/singleton effects exposed

themes: Overlapping predeclared lexical dictionaries aligned to provisional qualitative-reading code labels; counts are mentions, not validated semantic labels
claimedCivilizations: Explicit word-pattern families only; separate from practitioner/entity names and source-attributed groups. Orion and star-system names may be astronomical/fictional mentions. No disambiguated identity or civilization ontology is claimed.
rates: Pattern occurrences per1000 common analysis tokens; equal-document group means are primary; pooled-word group rates retained as a length sensitivity

networks.documentEdges: Undirected union of each document's two nearest lexical neighbors with cosine>=0.20
networks.civilizationEdges: Documents containing both dictionary families, counted once per document, separately by modality
networks.channelTopicEdges: Equal-document average normalized NMF topic weight within each publisher; publisher is not a medium

sensitivities: Central80percent of decoded audio time, as an imperfect intro/outro control
Leave one publisher group out with fixed ASR vocabulary/IDF and Hungarian topic matching
timeProfiles: Ten equal decoded-audio-time bins; each ASR segment assigned by midpoint; lexical rates use bin-token denominators; chunks/bins are not independent samples
privacy: Full transcript, segment and publisher text bodies and fitted sparse feature matrices stay outside Git. Public outputs contain numeric summaries, bounded top terms, source hashes and no source quotations.
inferenceLimits: Modality, author, publication date and source-format confounding
Source-claimed labels do not verify speakers or ET origins
Lexical similarity does not measure agreement, truth, independent transmission or shared physical origin
No human annotation accuracy, causal estimates, significance tests or population prevalence are claimed
negationMeasurementCaveat: Stoplist retention does not override document-frequency filtering: no/not/never are in all20ASR documents and removed by maxDf; nor is removed by minDf. Actual retained bigrams and synthetic contrast controls are exported.
figureFonts: PDF/PSfonttype42; all9PDFs inspected with pdffonts and have noType3
